summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To address these issues, we present the Refer360 dataset, a large-scale dataset of embodied verbal and nonverbal interactions collected across diverse viewpoints in...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We conduct extensive experiments on four HRI datasets, including the Refer360 dataset, and demonstrate that current multimodal models fail to capture embodied interactions...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 4 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: DZ-TDPO: Non-Destructive Temporal Alignment for Mutable State Tracking in Long-Context Dialogue
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**安全对齐与可解释性**（Safety & Interp）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **DZ-TDPO** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization），并引入 Experiments on the Multi-Session Chat (MSC) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To address this, we propose DZ-TDPO, a non-destructive alignment framework that synergizes conflict-aware dynamic KL constraints with a calibrated temporal attention bias。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **MMLU**；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **7B model**。实验设计与验证细节：Experiments on the Multi-Session Chat (MSC) dataset demonstrate that DZ-TDPO achieves state-of-the-art win rates (55.4% on Phi-3.5) while maintaining robust...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **55.4%, 50.8%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments on the Multi-Session Chat (MSC) dataset demonstrate that DZ-TDPO achieves state-of-the-art win rates...；Our scaling analysis reveals a "Capacity-Stability Trade-off": while smaller models incur an "alignment tax"...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作为突破 **小语言模型与端侧推理 (SLM & Edge)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: The SAM2-to-SAM3 Gap in the Segment Anything Model Family: Why Prompt-Based Expertise Fails in Concept-Driven Image Segmentation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」痛点，作者围绕 **The SAM2-to-SAM3 Gap in the** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖混合专家架构（Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)）。核心论点主张：This paper investigates the fundamental discontinuity between the latest two Segment Anything Models: SAM2 and SAM3。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用稀疏专家路由与解耦表征设计。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We structure this analysis through five core components: (1) a Conceptual Break Between Prompt-Based and Concept-Based Segmentation, contrasting spatial prompt...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Together, these analyses establish SAM3 as a new class of segmentation foundation model and chart future directions for the emerging concept-driven segmentation era）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 1 赞，出自 Cornell University），本工作修正了对 **混合专家与动态深度 (MoE/MoD)、视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
